angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 594,824 km at 44.86 pc = 0.18 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 22.2922 +/- 0.0160 mas (same row, RUWE 0.89): 44.86 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.855 +/- 0.008 solar radii from Rosário et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 15337 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...686A.282R/abstract): 594,824 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.829 +/- 0.038 solar masses from Rosário et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 15337 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...686A.282R/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5131 +/- 74 K from Rosário et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 15337 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...686A.282R/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Rosário et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 15337 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...686A.282R/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hd-15337.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.493, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 15337 (pscomppars): spectral type K1 V, from Gandolfi et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019ApJ...876L..24G/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 15337: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 15337 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.03 dex, from Rosário et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...686A.282R/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 15337 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.32606, from Dumusque et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019A&A...627A..43D/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 15337 (pscomppars): age 9.6 Gyr, from Rosário et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...686A.282R/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 15337 (pscomppars): rotation period 36.528 d, from Gandolfi et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019ApJ...876L..24G/abstract)
